fixes.fix: Level 1: 1,450 dollars a month – and I'm staring at my new date's smart fridge screen in absolute panic because his group chat just called me a cheap grocery store peach.
Level 5: 3,800 dollars a month – and I'm double-parked in front of a luxury high-rise, trying to deliver Tyler's replacement smart fridge screen before the police trace it back to my van.

rounds.fazit: Hervorragende Umsetzung des 'Versteckter Wert'-Prinzips mit starkem Worldbuilding, klaren Konflikten und genial vernetzten Charakteren über alle 8 Level hinweg.
